verdict.rationale: The only related item says users can "obtain clarifications" on tax and customs obligations. That reads as a support or inquiry channel, not published plain-language, step-by-step explainers for a non-lawyer. Nothing else in the pack shows guides, how-tos or walkthroughs, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.
